notablePrerequisites:
The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You control your commander.
description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to your commander's ability granted to it by Master Chef.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
